name: worktree-guard
description: Blocks Claude from editing files or running write commands on protected branches (default: main, master) so parallel sessions work in git worktrees.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names Claude may not change. A trailing * matches a prefix, e.g. release/*

allowedCommands.title: Allowed shell commands on protected branches
allowedCommands.description: Comma-separated command prefixes still allowed on a protected branch (read-only commands are always allowed).
